news.title: Purdue Engineering faculty selected for prestigious NAE symposium
news.summary_en: Three Purdue Engineering faculty members have been selected by the National Academy of Engineering (NAE) to participate in the 2026 Grainger Foundation Frontiers of Engineering Symposium, one of the nation's premier programs recognizing outstanding early-career engineers.

news.title: Joint proposal including BME's Wallace wins $160-NSF grant to study musculoskeletal health
news.summary_en: Purdue and its partners are aiming to help improve treatment for musculoskeletal diseases, such as osteoarthritis or osteoporosis, which place a significant burden on health, quality of life and the healthcare system as a whole.
